ImageDescription.value: 500px provided description: The two bronze statues of Bulgarian writers Slaveikovi are keeping an eye on the annual turning of the book market square into a garment sale. The garments are called martenitsi and are traditionally made and gifted in Bulgaria on 1st of March. Most of the ones for sale are made in China though and there is little to be sensed from the ancient tradition now. [#street ,#future ,#sale ,#values ,#bookmarket ,#martenitsi ,#Slaveikov]
